messages.subject: Mixed model with INLA
parts:
Hello, 

Since I upgraded INLA, I can not fit mixed model in the same way as before. 

Code below show how I fit mixed model on two group data. Random effect represent time and Z matrix indicate penalized splines, with two options to have same 
(ZSplSame) and different (ZSplDiff) spline per group. If I run code on the old version of INLA give me the attached plot1, where in the first row fitted curve have the same 
shape for both groups, while in the second row curves differ per group. After I upgraded INLA same and different splines give identical fit as in the plot2 and also I get warning message. 

Could you tell me how to overcome this problem and whether warning message have any impact on estimation of the model.

Best regards, 
Viktorian.

ge1 <- c(9,8,5,6,4,5,2,4)
ge2 <- c(8,5,4,7,8,7,10,11)
ge <- c(ge1,ge2)

# Time effect
timefac <- c(rep(1:8, 2))
# Group effect
groupfac <- factor(rep(1:2, each=8))

# Design matrix for random effect (Splines)
ZSpl <- matrix(c(28.51380432,13.83085771,5.32035999,1.29891601,0.08313062,0.01039133,0.66504500,3.56422554,
             3.56422554,0.66504500,0.01039133,0.08313062,1.29891601,5.32035999,13.83085771,28.51380432),8,2)
ZSplSame <- rbind(ZSpl,ZSpl)         # Same spline for both groups
ZSplDiff <- kronecker(diag(2),ZSpl)  # Different splines per group

# Fit model with same spline per group
form = ge ~ groupfac + f(timefac, model="z", Z=ZSplSame, hyper="loggamma", param=c(0.001,0.001)) -1
fit = inla(form, data=data.frame(ge=ge, groupfac=groupfac, timefac=timefac), family="gaussian", control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE))

# Fit model with different spline per group                
form = ge ~ groupfac + f(timefac, model="z", Z=ZSplDiff, hyper="loggamma", param=c(0.001,0.001)) -1
fit1 = inla(form, data=data.frame(ge=ge, groupfac=groupfac, timefac=timefac), family="gaussian", control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE))

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

#Plot same spline
plot(ge[1:8], main="Same spline, group 1", xlab="Time points", ylab="Expression")
lines(fit$summary.fitted.values[[1]][1:8])
plot(ge[9:16], main="Same spline, group 2", xlab="Time points", ylab="Expression")
lines(fit$summary.fitted.values[[1]][9:16])

#Plot different spline
plot(ge[1:8], main="Different spline, group 1", xlab="Time points", ylab="Expression")
lines(fit1$summary.fitted.values[[1]][1:8])
plot(ge[9:16], main="Different spline, group 2", xlab="Time points", ylab="Expression")
lines(fit1$summary.fitted.values[[1]][9:16])
